reviews.title: AS3 Wave 7 runtime conformance for native, Stage3D, media, net, display and system APIs
reviews.summary: Promote 113 AS3 Flash Player declarations implemented and verified in the ActionScript runtime and execute.mjs (native function dispatch, NetStream.checkPolicyFile, LoaderContext/JPEGLoaderContext, Capabilities, VideoTexture & ATF compressed textures, VideoStreamSettings/H264/VP6/AudioDeviceManager, Responder, NetStreamPlayOptions, SharedObject sync, Stage/InteractiveObject soft keyboard).
